hints: Focus on what type of change this is, a primary alcohol to an aldehyde is a gentle partial oxidation that must be stopped halfway.
Recall that both acidified manganate(VII) and dichromate(VI) can do this partial oxidation if you distil off the aldehyde as soon as it forms.
Think about what Tollens' reagent actually oxidises, and whether an alcohol is strong enough a reducing agent to react with it.
walkthrough:
**Identify the transformation**

Look at the starting material and product carefully. $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH}$ is propan-1-ol, a primary alcohol. $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CHO}$ is propanal, an aldehyde.

This is partial oxidation:
$$\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CH}_2\text{OH} + [O] \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CHO} + \text{H}_2\text{O}$$

**Check statements 1 and 2**

Both acidified $\text{KMnO}_4$ and acidified $\text{K}_2\text{Cr}_2\text{O}_7$ are strong oxidising agents. Under suitable conditions, gentle warming with distillation, they will oxidise a primary alcohol to an aldehyde.

Distillation is the key trick. The aldehyde boils off as soon as it forms, so it cannot stay to be further oxidised to the carboxylic acid. So 1 and 2 are both correct.

**Check statement 3**

Tollens' reagent, ammoniacal silver nitrate, is a very mild oxidising agent. It is used as a test for aldehydes, it oxidises aldehydes to carboxylic acids, but it is not strong enough to oxidise alcohols.

So propan-1-ol will give no reaction with Tollens' reagent. Statement 3 is incorrect.

Therefore only 1 and 2 are correct.

options.A: Incorrect. This option claims 1, 2 and 3 are all correct. While 1 and 2 work with distillation, 3 is wrong because Tollens' reagent cannot oxidise an alcohol to an aldehyde.
options.B: Correct. Both acidified manganate(VII) and acidified dichromate(VI) will oxidise propan-1-ol to propanal if the aldehyde is distilled off immediately to prevent further oxidation. Tollens' reagent will not.
options.C: Incorrect. This option claims 2 and 3 are correct. It wrongly includes Tollens' reagent, which does not react with alcohols, and wrongly excludes manganate(VII), which does work.
options.D: Incorrect. This option claims only 1 is correct. It correctly includes manganate(VII) but wrongly leaves out dichromate(VI), which works in exactly the same way under distillation conditions.
